description:
If you are passionate about innovation and technology and wish to contribute to developing knowledge, methods, and tools that will help companies, organisations and society, join us for a PhD project at DTU Engineering Technology. You will work at the intersection between research and industry in an application-focused environment and influence how technology succeeds in practice by focusing on technology implementation in Danish SMEs.

The PhD project will study how SMEs transition through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes, e.g. to fasten the time-to-market of new products. When SMEs become established and implement new technology, they often transition from being agile, customer centric and entrepreneurial to more structured and focused on internal processes. In doing so, they lose the startup approach, which results in longer time-to-market for new products.

The project will follow the journey of navigating the complexity of technology implementation in multiple Danish SMEs over time, and the successful candidate will define and pursue a research project within this frame. Relevant perspectives include innovation management, technology implementation, human-centred design, and organisational management. The project is expected to combine rigorous empirical research with the development and evaluation of new approaches, contributing both to academic knowledge and to the advancement of educational practices at DTU.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall focus will be to develop and conduct research on SMEs transitions through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes. You will contribute to both research and teaching activities within DTU Engineering Technology.

Your primary tasks will be to:
  • Develop and execute an independent PhD research project within technology implementation
  • Study the impact of organizational and contextual changes on technology implementation outcomes within the context of Danish SMEs
  • Design and evaluate a practice-based toolset define the combinations of methods and tools for technology implementation
  • Collect and analyse empirical data using qualitative and/or quantitative methods
  • Publish research findings in high-quality academic journals and conferences
  • Contribute to teaching, supervision, and development of courses and learning activities
  • Collaborate with colleagues and partners across DTU Engineering Technology

The ideal candidate has an educational background relevant to innovation management, technology implementation or organisational management. Applicants must be fluent in English and Danish.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Giulia Nardelli (ginar@dtu.dk).

You can read more about DTU Engineering Technology at https://engtech.dtu.dk/english.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU.

Application procedure
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 9 August 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Engineering Technology
We work at the forefront of university-industry collaboration and develop tools and methods for technology implementation. We are organized in 8 sections all focused on technology implementation, engineering technology and engineering education within a wide range of engineering fields.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Business Developer
description:
Commercial decisions are only as good as the insights behind them. At SELECTED, we're building a new Business Development team to help our markets make even better commercial decisions.

As one of the first members of the team, you'll work at the intersection of business and data. Together with commercial stakeholders across Europe, you'll turn insights into action and help shape how commercial decisions are made.

YOUR TEAM
You will join a newly established Business Development team at SELECTED. Together, we work to strengthen commercial decision-making by connecting business understanding, data and technology. Joining us from at an early stage, you'll have the opportunity to influence how we work, build strong relationships across the organisation and make an impact from day one.
Working closely with Country Sales Managers, Sales Representatives, Merchandise Managers and Partner Performance Managers across our European markets, you'll help shape how data creates value in the business. You'll also collaborate with colleagues in our buying organisation as well as BESTSELLER Tech to develop commercial data products that support our decision-making across the value chain.

YOUR ROLE
You'll help strengthen commercial decision-making across SELECTED by combining business understanding with data. Working closely with colleagues across our sales organisation and markets, you'll identify opportunities, develop tools and analyses and help colleagues make better and faster decisions across our markets.

More specifically, you will:

  • Analyse commercial performance across partners and markets to identify opportunities and recommend where actions will create the greatest value

  • Develop tools, analyses and AI-supported solutions that help our sales organisation make better and faster commercial decisions

  • Drive the adoption of data-driven ways of working through stakeholder engagement, collaboration and training

  • Support our buying organisation by bringing commercial insights into product-related decisions and processes

  • Collaborate with BESTSELLER Tech to shape and continuously improve commercial data products that create value across the business.

YOUR BENEFITS
This isn't a role where insights disappear into a report. You'll work closely with the people making commercial decisions, giving you the opportunity to challenge, advise and see the impact of your work first-hand. You'll also:

  • Help build a new function with room to influence priorities and ways of working

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders across Europe, our buying organisation and BESTSELLER Tech

  • Benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home, which is a natural part of how we work at SELECTED.

YOUR PROFILE
You're curious about what drives commercial performance and motivated by making a real impact through data. You enjoy navigating between business and analytics, and you're at your best when collaborating with others to solve complex commercial challenges. 

In addition, we imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant Master's degree, for example within Economics and Business Administration (cand.merc.), Business Intelligence or Data Science, or a similar field

  • Have experience working with commercial data and business insights, ideally within fashion, wholesale, retail or a comparable industry

  • Understand how commercial performance, partner dynamics and product decisions influence business results

  • Are comfortable working with analytical tools such as SQL, Python or similar, and enjoy using modern technologies, including AI, to develop analyses and practical solutions

  • Communicate complex insights in a simple and actionable way to stakeholders with different backgrounds

  • Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Business Development Manager Alex Brink Poulsen. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 4 August 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting when we find the right candidate.

title: Drone Technician
description:
Drone Technician

Reblade ApS – Denmark

Danish Award-Winning Team and Technology

Reblade is a Danish deep-tech startup founded in 2020, developing autonomous drone systems

for wind turbine blade repair. We combine robotics, UAV technology, computer vision,

advanced sensors, and software to automate one of the most challenging maintenance tasks in the

renewable energy industry.

Our multidisciplinary team consists of highly skilled engineers within robotics, software,

electronics, mechanical engineering, and computer vision. We have several PhDs, post-docs, and

a professor on the team, and our international culture is built around innovation, technical

excellence, and collaboration.

As recipients of multiple European innovation awards and funding programs, we are rapidly

growing our engineering organization and are looking for talented people who want to develop

cutting-edge technology with real-world impact.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Drone Technician to join our hardware team in Denmark.

You will play a key role in preparing, assembling, maintaining, and testing our UAV systems,

ensuring they are ready for laboratory development, field testing, and customer demonstrations.

Working closely with software, electronics, and mechanical engineers, you will help ensure our

systems operate safely and reliably.

Responsibilities

• Assemble, configure, and maintain UAV systems and payloads.

• Perform preventive maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of drones and supporting

equipment.

• Prepare drones and equipment for laboratory testing, field deployments, and customer

demonstrations.

• Perform pre-flight and post-flight inspections.

• Manage batteries, charging systems, spare parts, tools, and workshop inventory.

• Support flight testing and operational deployments.

• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and technical findings.• Contribute to the continuous improvement of assembly, maintenance, and testing

procedures.

Requirements

Essential

• Technical education within electronics, mechanics, aviation, mechatronics, or a related

technical field.

• Hands-on experience assembling and maintaining UAVs or similar electromechanical

systems.

• Experience with commercial or industrial UAV operations.

• Minimum 100 documented flight hours operating medium or large UAVs.

• Valid EU Remote Pilot Certificates A1/A3 and A2.

• Strong troubleshooting and practical problem-solving skills.

• Ability to read technical documentation and follow assembly procedures.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused approach.

• Good English communication skills.

• Willingness to relocate to Denmark.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with ArduPilot or similar flight control systems.

• Experience supporting UAV testing and customer demonstrations.

• Experience working in robotics, prototype development, or R&D environments.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge autonomous drone technology.

• Be part of an award-winning international engineering team.

• High level of responsibility and technical ownership.

• Fast-paced startup environment where your work has immediate impact.

Location

Denmark (On-site)Employment Type

Full-time

Join us in shaping the future of autonomous wind turbine blade maintenance through

robotics and drone technology.

title: Socialpædagog søges til Børne- og ungehjem
description:
Behandlingsinstitutioner Curam søger snarest en socialpædagog til afdeling Grønnebjerg

Curams målgruppe er børn og unge mellem 14-23 år med multiple problemstillinger, herunder omsorgssvigt, udviklingstraume, tilknytningsforstyrrelser, kriminalitet og misbrug. Vi har plads til i alt 15 unge, fordelt på 3 afdelinger, ligesom vi har ansvaret for 4 unge der bor i egen bolig, alle i Skibby. Stillingen er ledig i vores afdeling Grønnebjerg i Kirke Såby, og har plads til 5 unge mellem 14-17 år.

Arbejdestiden er mellem 7.00-23.00 i et 4 ugers rul, og laves i samarbejde med de øvrige ansatte. Man skal være indstillet på at arbejde 2-4 eftermiddag/after pr uge og mindst en weekend (fredag/lørdag eller lørdag/søndag) pr. måned. Natarbejde kommer ikke på tale, da vi har faste nattevagter.

Ansøger med kendskab til arbejdet med udsatte børn og unge vil blive foretrukket, ligesom kendskab til misbrugsproblematikker og udadreagerende adfærd er en klar fordel.

Robusthed, ro, empati og mentaliseringskompetncer, er sammen med en respektfuld og anerkendende tilgang til målgruppen og dennes familie, nødvendige kompetencer.

Ansvarlighed og ordentlighed er en forudsætning, ligesom humor og samarbejdsevne er centrale elementer for den rette ansøger. 

Vi tilbyder god løn, oplæring, kurser og supervision, ligesom der er tilrettelagt en 1-årig intern efteruddannelse for den samlede personalegruppe med opstart maj 2026. Desuden vægter vi en god omgangstone, frihed under ansvar, kollegial sparring og har nogle super gode fysiske rammer, både til personalet og de unge.

Vi arbejder ud fra en tilknytningsteoretisk, systemisk narrativ og kropsorienteret tilgang.

Værdigrundlag:

  • Vi tror på, at alle børn og unge har ressourcer og styrker og alle gør det bedst de kan.

  • Vi tror på, at enhver person har ret til at blive behandlet individuelt ud fra en særligt tilrettelagt og målrettet behandlingstænkning, der tager højde for barnet/den unges livshistorie, følelsesmæssige samt kognitive forudsætninger for at kunne indgå i kontakt og relation med sin omverden.

  • Vi tror på, at professionelle, som er autentiske, træder i karakter, og som ikke er bange for at involvere sig og sætte sig selv i spil, kan gøre en forskel.

  • Vi tror på, at positive forandringer bedst skabes i et positivt defineret felt. Vi tager altid udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske og lægger vægt på, at alle bliver mødt med en forståelse for de vanskeligheder barnet/den unge har med sig.

  • Vi tror på, at en helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor hele netværker inddrages, er den bedste forudsætning for forandring, der også holder på længere sigt.

Kørsel i egen bil kan i nødstilfælde være nødvendigt, hvis alle Curams biler er optaget.

Med venlig hilsen

Flemming Zuschlag Christihansen

Aut. psykolog og forstander

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für das Data-Engineering-Team und prägst maßgeblich die technische Ausrichtung unserer Data-Engineering-Praktiken im gesamten Unternehmen. Du schreibst Code, definierst Standards und unterstützt sowie coachst andere Engineers. Gleichzeitig bist du die zentrale technische Eskalationsstelle für komplexe Herausforderungen.

- Sehr sicher in Python, PySpark und SQL bist – inklusive komplexer Transformationen, Performanceoptimierung und Query-Design

title: Erfaren chefkonsulent til ledelses- og organisationsudvikling i KL
description:
Vil du være med til at styrke ledelses- og organisationsudviklingen i KL, og til at sikre den fortsatte udvikling af KL som en stærk og indflydelsesrig interesseorganisation? Vi leder efter en fagligt stærk kollega, der kan være med til at drive og understøtte strategiske HR-initiativer inden for organisations-, kompetence- og ledelsesudvikling.

KL er en kompleks politisk organisation, hvor vi arbejder for demokratiet og for at sikre kommunernes fælles interesser. I Organisationsudvikling & HR udvikler og driver vi aktiviteter, der skal styrke KL's potentiale og muligheder for at varetage kommunernes interesser.

Vi står som kontor midt i maskinrummet i en spændende og dynamisk organisation, hvor vi har tæt kontakt til chefer, medarbejdere og direktion samt til vores medlemmer - de danske kommuner. Vi sætter barren højt og arbejder altid for at gøre tingene endnu bedre.

Din hverdag i KL

Du bliver en del af et kontor med en bred opgaveportefølje og får en central rolle i udviklingen og gennemførelsen af KL's interne udviklingsaktiviteter.

Dine opgaver vil især ligge inden for følgende områder, men den konkrete opgavefordeling sker i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer:
  • Organisationsudvikling: Understøtte organisatoriske forandringer, tværgående samarbejder og vidensdeling samt udvikle og facilitere kontorseminarer.
  • Strategiske HR-processer: Drive og udvikle processer inden for lokalløn og overenskomster, samt samarbejde med tillids- og arbejdsmiljørepræsentanter.
  • Ledelsesudvikling: Udvikle, planlægge og gennemføre sammenhængende ledelsesudviklingsforløb.
  • Ledelsessparring: Sparring med kontorchefer om udviklingen af kontorets ressourcer, fx i forhold til bl.a. samarbejde, kompetencer, rekruttering og løn, i samarbejde med kollegaerne i kontoret.
  • Kompetenceudvikling: Udvikle, planlægge og gennemføre kompetenceudviklingstilbud særligt målrettet KL og de kompetencer, som er særligt relevante for KL's kerneopgave, fx interessevaretagelse.

I Organisationsudvikling & HR løser vi opgaver i tæt samarbejde på tværs af kontoret. Du får derfor en hverdag, hvor du både har ansvar for egne opgaver og bidrager til fælles indsatser sammen med kollegaerne. Afhængigt af dine erfaringer og interesser kan du også komme til at arbejde med øvrige HR-områder, fx arbejdsmiljø eller forhandling af løn og overenskomster.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse, gerne suppleret med efteruddannelse inden for fx ledelse eller organisationspsykologi. Du har formentlig flere års relevant erfaring med at drive ledelses- og organisationsudvikling fx fra en kommune, centraladministrationen eller en interesseorganisation.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med at udvikle og implementere ledelses- og organisationsudviklingen fra spæd idé til forankring i praksis.
  • Kan skabe fremdrift i komplekse opgaver og processer, også når målet endnu ikke er fuldt defineret, og har procestålmodighed til at fastholde retning og momentum
  • Har erfaring med rådgivning og sparring med chefer
  • Er en stærk facilitator, der er i stand til at skabe tryghed, energi og retning
  • Har kendskab til og erfaring med arbejdet i en politisk ledet organisation
  • Kan indsamle og analysere både kvalitative og kvantitative data og oversætte dem til udviklingstiltag og anbefalinger
  • Har stærke samarbejdsevner og trives med at opbygge relationer til særligt kontorchefer (personaleledere), samt direktion og øvrige kollegaer på tværs af huset
  • Har erfaring med, eller lyst til at udvikle din erfaring med, at anvende testværktøjer som led i udvikling og rekruttering
  • Er nysgerrig på at forstå, hvordan KL bedst udvikler sig for at styrke kommuner, kommunalpolitik og lokalt demokrati

Vi tilbyder dig

I KL bliver du en del af en organisation med ca. 400 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder for at styrke kommunernes interesser. Du får en central rolle i at drive og videreudvikle aktiviteter og initiativer målrettet KL som organisation, og du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø med stort ansvar, gode udviklingsmuligheder og opgaver med både politisk og strategisk betydning.

Organisationsudvikling & HR er et kontor med 15 engagerede kollegaer med et stærkt tværgående samarbejde. Kontoret arbejder med en bred opgaveportefølje, der blandt andet omfatter politisk organisering, tværgående sekretariatsopgaver, organisationsudvikling, HR, løn- og personaleadministration samt relationer til KL's tilknyttede virksomheder.

Hos os får du en hverdag med afveksling, samarbejde og mulighed for at følge opgaver fra idé til gennemførelse i en organisation med høj faglighed, stærkt kollegaskab og gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling. Du får mulighed for at sætte dit aftryk på en kompleks organisation, hvor processerne sjældent er lineære. Nogle gange er der kort fra tanke til handling, mens andre processer kan strække sig og har flere tilbageløb.

Det praktiske

Send os din ansøgning senest den 16. august 2026. Vi håber at kunne byde dig velkommen den 1. oktober 2026.

Vi holder første samtale den 21. august, formentlig som en kortere screeningssnak. Herefter følger et testforløb, samt en anden samtale, som er planlagt til den 27. august.

Der kan blive gennemført både test og case i forbindelse med 2. samtalerunde, ligesom der forud for ansættelsen indhentes referencer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger den relevante overenskomst i KL med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer.

Er du nysgerrig på at høre mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Julie Appelt Honoré på telefonnummer 61669927.

KL er interesse- og medlemsorganisation for de 98 kommunalbestyrelser i Danmark. KL bidrager til at udvikle og fastholde et stærkt lokalt demokrati. KL varetager kommunernes fælles interesser og er kommunernes samlede forhandlingsorganisation, videnscenter og forum for fælles initiativer og beslutninger.

KL ser forskellighed i medarbejdersammensætningen og i ledelsen som en af vores styrker og opfordrer alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund til at søge vores ledige stillinger.

Kig forbi vores KL Karriereunivers og lær mere om os som arbejdsplads og medarbejdere. https://www.kl.dk/karriereunivers/forside

title: Postdoc in BioPhysics
description:
Many microorganisms, such as bacteria and cancer cells, exhibit remarkable collective dynamics, often described as "living liquids" or active fluids, and arise due to local internal energy injection. Likeconventional liquids, the macro-scale confinement, or boundaries, of thfluid can control their flow patterns, and the micro-scale behaviour of the microorganisms. However, many physical systems exist within a deformable environment such as the mucus layers in the body.

As a result, not only does this living liquid get affected by its environment, but it can also reshape its soft surroundings as a form of mechanoreciprocity. This leads to a range of fascinating phenomena, such as cancer cells invading surrounding extracellular matrix, soil-dwelling bacteria burrowing through sand, and the infection of mucus by pathogenic bacteria. This research project will use computational models to explore the bidirectional relationship between an organism’s motility and its adaptable environment, investigating how microorganisms not only adapt to, but also actively restructure their surroundings.

This application is posted with a corresponding PhD position and only one of the positions will be filled. We are looking for candidates interested in biophysical systems and computational physics, with a preference for some knowledge about programming.

The postdoc’s duties will include research within biophysics as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties.

Further information on the Department is linked at the NBI website. Inquiries about the position can be made to Kristian Thijssen, Kristian.thijssen@nbi.ku.dk.

Terms of employment

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically through UCPH Job Portal.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Please include

title: Assistant Professors of Molecular Imaging
description:
We are looking for three highly motivated and dynamic assistant professors who can lead molecular imaging projects as part of a 3-year position to commence between November 2026 and February 2027.

Our research
Cluster for Molecular Imaging was established in 2004 by Professor Andreas Kjær to pursue translational molecular imaging research. The research is driven by unmet medical needs and includes all steps from molecule identification to evaluation in patients with a strong focus on the transfer of new methods into clinical practice. The research covers several disease areas including oncology, immune-oncology, cardiovascular diseases, and inflammatory diseases. The group has so far translated 5 PET tracers into the clinic.

Cluster for Molecular Imaging has access to all necessary facilities for molecular imaging, including preclinical and clinical imaging facilities, cyclotrons, and radiochemistry as well as laboratories for molecular biology, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, and a cell laboratory.

The group currently consists of 40 researchers covering a wide range of disciplines, including medicine, pharmacy, chemistry, engineering, biology, molecular biology, and physics.

Your job
You will join a multidisciplinary research team working on translational molecular imaging.

You are expected to design, execute and analyse high impact translational research related to molecular imaging. The exact project(s) to be conducted depends on the candidate’s background and experiences.

The assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination duties
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
  • Supporting fundraising activities
Profile
Six overall criteria apply for assistant professor appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding, and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit.

Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience:

Essential experience and skills:

  • You have a PhD in Molecular Imaging or an adjacent field
  • You have an active interest in translational medical research and innovation
  • You have documented pre- and postgraduate teaching experience
  • Proficient communication skills and ability to work in teams
  • Strong publication record corresponding to your career stage
  • Excellent English skills written and spoken
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Experience within areas such as oncology, immunology, infectious diseases or related biomedical fields
  • Experience working across academic, clinical, and/or industry settings
  • Interest in innovation, translational science, or implementation of research into practice
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Biomedical Sciences, Panum Institute, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week for 1 position, and 18,5 hours for 2 positions.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is in Ot

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 40,000 DKK (November 2025 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information please contact Daniel Murray, daniel.murray@sund.ku.dk.

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (Max. one page)
  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position
  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do
  4. List of publications
  5. Teaching portfolio (If applicable)
Deadline for applications is 16 August 2026, 23.59 (CEST)

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

title: Studentermedhjælper til Administrationen – DTU Sundhedsteknologi
description:
Administrationen på DTU Sundhedsteknologi søger en elle to studentermedhjælpere, der har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt institut med en bred kontaktflade til både danske og internationale medarbejdere.

Du får en vigtig rolle i at understøtte den daglige drift gennem forskellige administrative opgaver og samtidig mulighed for at få erfaring med administration på et universitet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:
  • Support i forbindelse med timeregistrering
  • Support i forbindelse med kreditkortafregninger
  • Håndtering og opfølgning af fakturaer
  • Administrative opgaver relateret til studieområdet
  • Løbende ad hoc-opgaver

Den konkrete opgavefordeling afhænger af din profil og af, om vi ansætter en eller flere studentermedhjælpere.

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med 14 kollegaer, som understøtter instituttets forskere og øvrige medarbejdere med en bred vifte af administrative opgaver.

Vores forventninger til dig:
  • Du arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret
  • Du behersker både dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale
  • Du kan hurtigt sætte dig ind i nye systemer
  • Du trives med rutineprægede opgaver
  • Du har gode samarbejdsevner
  • Du er fleksibel og har et godt overblik

Hvad tilbyder vi dig:
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer
  • Et fleksibelt studiejob, som kan tilpasses din hverdag med undervisning, eksaminer og ferier
  • Erfaring med administrative opgaver inden for universitetsverdenen og indblik i den daglige drift i en administrativ afdeling

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer m.fl. (HK/Stat).

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt 15 timer om ugen. Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. september eller snarest derefter. Ansættelsen løber, så længe du er aktiv studerende.

Arbejdssted er DTU Lyngby Campus.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Vi skal modtage din online ansøgning senest den 20. august 2026. Åbn linket "Ansøg nu", hvor du udfylder ansøgningsformularen samt vedhæfter din motiverede ansøgning, CV og dokumentation for studieaktivitet. I ansøgningen vil vi gerne høre lidt om dig, dine kompetencer og hvorfor du søger stillingen.

Ønsker du flere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte administrationschef Sannie H. Christensen på tlf. 6139 6352.

Ansøgninger modtaget efter ansøgningsfristens udløb tages ikke i betragtning.

Alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold, opfordres til at søge stillingen. Da DTU arbejder med forskning i kritisk teknologi, hvormed der gælder særlige regler for blandt andet sikkerhed og eksportkontrol, kan der blive foretage open source-baggrundstjek af kvalificerede kandidater til stillingen.

DTU Sundhedsteknologi
Med udgangspunkt i visionen om at forbedre sundhed og livskvalitet gennem teknologi arbejder DTU Sundhedsteknologi med forskning, uddannelse og innovation baseret på naturvidenskaben og den tekniske videnskab. Vi uddanner fremtidens sundsteknologiske ingeniører og skaber grundlaget for nye og innovative services og teknologier til en på verdensplan voksende sundhedssektor, der stiller krav om avancerede teknologiske løsninger. DTU Sundhedsteknologis ekspertise kan beskrives gennem fem overordnede forskningsområder: Diagnostic Imaging, Digital Health, Personalised Therapy, Precision Diagnostics og Sensory and Neural Technology. Vores teknologier og løsninger er udviklet med et formål om at være til gavn for mennesker og skabe værdi for samfundet. Instituttet inkluderer omkring 210 videnskabelige medarbejdere, 140 ph.d.-studerende, og et teknisk / administrativt personale på omkring 100 personer, hvoraf en stor del bidrager til vores forskningsinfrastruktur og relaterede kommercielle aktiviteter.

DTU – Til gavn for samfundet siden 1829
DTU er et af Europas førende tekniske eliteuniversiteter. Med forskning og uddannelser i international topklasse skaber vi løsninger på tidens store samfundsmæssige udfordringer og bidrager til at sikre Europas globale førerposition inden for bæredygtig teknologiudvikling. Siden H.C. Ørsted grundlagde DTU for snart 200 år siden, har vores mission været den samme: Vi udvikler og nyttiggør naturvidenskab og teknisk videnskab til gavn for samfundet. DTU har 13.800 studerende, 1.600 ph.d.-studerende og 6.500 ansatte. Vi arbejder i et internationalt miljø og har en inkluderende, udviklende og uformel arbejdskultur. DTU har campusser i hele Danmark og i Grønland og samarbejder med de bedste universiteter verden over.

Kok Søges Til Væveriet

Vi søger en dygtig faglært kok eller en kok med tilsvarende udenlandsk erfaring til Væveriet i Dalbygade.

Vi er hovedsageligt et eventkøkken, men laver også kokkeskoler, teambuilding, mad over bål i de varme sæsoner og en god del grill. Vi kører ikke faste, låste menuer året rundt, så der er plads til kreativitet, egne idéer og de retter, du selv brænder for at lave.

Vi er et lille hold med et stærkt sammenhold. Her løfter vi i flok, hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen, også når tempoet stiger.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Er faglært kok eller har tilsvarende udenlandsk erfaring.

  • Er rigtig god til at lave mad.

  • Har et solidt grundrepertoire og ikke skal starte med opskriften hver gang.

  • Har interesse for råvarer, smag og god afvikling.

  • Kan holde aftaler og møde forberedt.

  • Er en god kollega og bidrager til fællesskabet.

  • Har fornuftig fysik og er klar på at knokle, når der er travlt.

  • Har humor og kan holde hovedet koldt.

  • Er fleksibel med arbejdstiderne.

  • Ikke går i panik, fordi der pludselig har sneget sig en ekstra veganer, allergiker eller FODMAP-gæst ind i selskabet.

Du behøver ikke have 15 års erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du kan dit håndværk, har lyst til at udvikle dig og elsker følelsen af, at et travlt køkken bare spiller.

Vi er skarpe på tidsplaner, afvikling og varm mad til mange mennesker. Samtidig er vi et hus, hvor der sker meget, så du skal være med på, at vi hjælper hinanden på tværs, når det giver mening. Til gengæld har vi faktisk ret godt styr på tingene.

Arbejdet ligger naturligvis ofte, når andre har fri. Klargøring og forberedelse kan til gengæld i høj grad planlægges fornuftigt.

Vi tilbyder pension, sundhedsforsikring, feriepenge og løn efter kompetencer og ansvarsområder. Arbejder du mange lørdage, tager vi selvfølgelig også en snak om, at lønnen skal afspejle det.

Tiltrædelse snarest, men vi venter gerne på den rigtige profil.

Send en ansøgning til rasmus@vaeveriet.com.

Chef Wanted At Væveriet

We are looking for a skilled trained chef or a chef with equivalent international experience to join Væveriet in Dalbygade.

We are primarily an event kitchen, but we also run cooking classes, teambuilding events, open-fire cooking in the warmer seasons and quite a bit of grilling. We do not work with fixed, locked menus all year round, so there is room for creativity, your own ideas and the dishes you genuinely enjoy making.

We are a small team with a strong sense of community. We help each other, lift together and keep the mood good, even when things get busy.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is a trained chef or has equivalent international experience.

  • Is genuinely good at cooking.

  • Has a solid basic repertoire and does not need to start from a recipe every time.

  • Cares about ingredients, flavour and smooth service.

  • Keeps agreements and shows up prepared.

  • Is a good colleague and contributes to the team.

  • Has decent physical stamina and is ready to work hard when needed.

  • Has a sense of humour and can keep calm under pressure.

  • Is flexible with working hours.

  • Does not panic when an extra vegan, allergy or FODMAP guest suddenly appears on the function sheet.

You do not need 15 years of experience. What matters most is that you know your craft, want to develop and enjoy the feeling of a busy kitchen running well.

We are sharp on timing, execution and serving hot food to large groups. At the same time, Væveriet is a place where many things happen, so you should be willing to help across the house when it makes sense. In return, we are actually quite structured and usually have a good grip on things.

The work naturally often takes place when other people are off. Prep and planning, however, can usually be arranged in a sensible way.

We offer pension, health insurance, holiday pay and salary based on skills and areas of responsibility. If you work many Saturdays, we will of course discuss a salary that reflects that.

Start as soon as possible, but we are happy to wait for the right profile.

Send your application to rasmus@vaeveriet.com.

title: Event Operations Coordinator
description:

Arbejdsopgaver

·         Koordinere kundeforespørgsler, bookinger og eventkalender.

·         Udarbejde bemandings- og arbejdsplaner til arrangementer.

·         Sikre, at udstyr, råvarer og materialer er klar før hvert arrangement.

·         Bidrage til udvikling af effektive arbejdsgange og sikre høj kvalitet i leverancerne.

Vi tilbyder

·         En fast fuldtidsstilling.

title: Plejecenterleder med øje for, hvilken retning vi skal.
description:
Er du klar til at tage et plejecenter under dine vinger og vise, hvordan kompetencer og fagligheder vokser i en frugtbar hverdag?

 

-Så lad din karriere blomstre videre på Trollehøj Plejecenter, hvor en sektionslederstilling venter på at stå i fuldt flor.

 

Hvad tilbyder vi i stillingen?
Trollehøj er et velfungerende plejecenter med cirka 50 kompetente og engagerede medarbejdere, der hver dag summer af engagement for et fagligt, tværfagligt og professionelt samarbejde for at skabe det bedste hjem for borgerne. 
Plejecentret består af 36 plejeboliger, der ligger i naturskønne omgivelser i den østlige del af Svendborg. 

På Trollehøj er der et stærkt fællesskab og stor villighed og lyst til at løse opgaverne.

Vi har et succesfyldt samarbejde med frivillige fra lokalområdet, som vi ønsker at udvide.

 

I sektionen er der fokus på medarbejdernes kompetencer i forhold til borgernes behov, og der er et tæt samarbejde med blandt andet læger, terapeuter, demenskonsulenter, Myndighedsafdelingen samt Hjælpemidler & Hverdagsteknologi. Vi har fokus på borgerperspektivet, og lægger vægt på at understøtte borgerne i at kunne leve det gode liv i hverdagen. Derfor vægter vi et godt samarbejde med borgere og pårørende.


Kollegialt bliver du en del af et velfungerende team med syv lederkollegaer i Plejecenter Øst, som arbejder tæt sammen om at løse opgaverne. Herudover har vi et nært samarbejde med de øvrige lederkollegaer på ældreområdet.


Svendborg Kommune har en visionær ledelsespolitik med fokus på ledelsesudvikling, både på det individuelle og det organisatoriske plan.

I forbindelse med din opstart designer vi et onboarding-program til dig, skræddersyet til dine behov og forudsætninger. Du tilknyttes en mentor og der er kontinuerlig sparring med din områdeleder, som du refererer til.

 

I det daglige har du et tæt samarbejde med husets sygeplejersker, sosu’er og øvrige medarbejdere, herunder tillidsvalgte og nøglepersoner. Og ikke mindst din kommende assisterende leder, som du vil være med til at ansætte. Den assisterende leder understøtter ledelse og planlægning. Du vil naturligvis også indgå i et tæt samarbejde med borgere, pårørende og plejecentrets frivillige hjælpere.

 

Du får administrativ assistance fra områdekontoret og fra ældreområdets stab, der bistår dig med eksempelvis udviklingsopgaver, kvalitetssikring og juridiske og faglige spørgsmål. Desuden kan du få sparring af kompetente HR-konsulenter og økonomikonsulenter.

 

Vi ønsker os at du:

  • At du går forrest og viser vejen med en struktureret ledelse, så alle præsterer bedst muligt i arbejdet. 
  • Har blikket der ser og møder medarbejdere med forskellige fagligheder og personligheder.
  • Ihærdigt arbejder med kultur og understøtter det stærke fællesskab.
  • Er synlig, tilgængelig og tydelig i din fremtræden
  • Får øje på de gode historier og hverdagsoplevelser.

 

Som sektionsleder på Trollehøj er forståelse for ledelsesansvar, samarbejde og sammenhæng i en stor organisation vigtige pejlemærker. Vi ser gerne, at du har en relevant sundhedsfaglig uddannelse og gerne ledelseserfaring. Måske har du allerede diplom i ledelse eller er indstillet på at tage uddannelsen. Det vil også være en stor fordel at du har erfaring med Personcentreret omsorg ud fra Kitt Woods teori om personcentreret omsorg.

 

Ansøgningen
I din ansøgning vil vi gerne læse konkrete eksempler på hvordan du:

 

  • Skaber motivation og får andre til at performe.
  • Er tydelig, nærværende og inkluderende i din ledelse.
  • Arbejder struktureret og skaber balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.
  • Reflekterer og kommunikerer i forbindelse med at du skal implementere og udvikle.
  • Har fokus på borgerperspektivet og det gode samarbejde med beboerne, pårørende og andre samarbejdspartnere.

     

Ældreområdet 

Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.
Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældreliv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed. 
Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og til din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for. 
Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kolleger at dele hverdagen med. 

 

 

Om Svendborg Kommune
Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling. 

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden. 

Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.

 

Løn og ansættelse

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Områdeleder Tine Hildebrand tlf.: 24 88 69 93

 

Ved stillingens besættelse skal en aktuel privat straffeattest forvises.

Der vil i rekrutteringsforløbet blive indhentet referencer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 48119,00 og 76333,00 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

 

Ansøgningsfrist den 29.08.26 kl 24.00

Tiltrædelse den 01.11.26 eller efter aftale.

 

1. samtale forventes afholdt den 09.09.26.

2. samtale forventes afholdt den 25.09.26.

Mulighed for individuel samtale med områdeleder i uge 38 og/eller uge 39.

Der vil være en profiltest mellem 1. og 2. samtale.

 

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

 

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

  • gode rammer for et aktivt udeliv

English Version:

Looking for chef for Cafe& restaurant in Frederiksberg

Experienced Chef Wanted – Café & Restaurant in Frederiksberg

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Chef to join our café & restaurant in Frederiksberg.

You should have experience preparing both brunch and à la carte dinner menus, be able to work independently, stay organized during busy periods, and have a strong focus on quality and great taste.

We offer:

title: Dyrehavens Naturbørnehave søger 2 naturglade pædagogmedhjælpere
description:
Skal du med vores unger ud i naturen?

Dyrehavens Naturbørnehave søger 2 medhjælpere med højt humør, der vil opleve naturen sammen med børn. Hos os er guitarspil og gakkede ideer mere end velkomne.

Dyrehavens Naturbørnehave er en børnehave, hvor vi har naturen med i næsten alt hvad vi laver. Vi har vores base i et hus, beliggende lige op ad Trongårdsskolen og Novozymes, hvorfra vi tager på vores mange ture i naturen eller benytter til pædagogiske aktiviteter inde som ude.

Vi er en lille privat institution med 31 naturglade børn og 7 voksne: Tre pædagoger og fire medhjælpere. Måske skal du være den ene af de fire medhjælpere? Vi er pt 2 mænd og fem kvinder, som glæder os til at byde dig velkommen i vores hyggelige hus med krearum, legerum og køkken, og vores endnu hyggeligere have med bålhytte, plantekasser og masser af plads til sjov og ballade. 2 af kvinderne er dem der stopper. Vi ligger lige ved Dyrehaven, Tordals Mose og Ermelunden og vi er ude og på ture i al slags vejr. Vi bruger naturen som udgangspunkt for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Vi har en sund økonomi og en stærk faglighed. Vores forældregruppe er meget aktive og klar til at deltage i og støtte op om de faglige temaer og aktiviteter, vi løbende arbejder med. Vi ser familierne som en tæt samarbejdspartner.

Vi glæder os til dine skøre ideer og omsorgsgen.

De 2 ledige stillinger er:

  • et vikariat, indtil februar, der måske kan blive lavet om til en fast stilling
  • og en fast stilling

Begge stillinger er på 32 timer og begge er med opstart d 1/9.

Den ene af stillingerne er til vores lillegruppe, så her søges der en rolig og omsorgsfuld person. Den den anden stilling kan bedre kan rumme en med lidt mere energi og gerne med lidt erfaring fra lignende arbejde eller med at arbejde i naturen. For begge stillinger gælder, at du måske er der, hvor du mangler det sidste skub, inden du skal i gang med en uddannelse. Vi håber, at du som kollega er fleksibel i en hverdag, hvor tingene kan ændre sig hurtigt. Og så må du meget gerne være lidt tosset og klar til skæve og skøre ideer. Kan du også spille guitar, ukulele eller andet instrument, bliver både vi og børnene rigtig glade.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du ringe til børnehavens leder, Mikkel, på 61712421, eller du kan kigge på www.dyreskov.dk

I Dyrehavens Naturbørnehave vil du blive ansat på overenskomst med Børneringen, som er vores paraplyorganisation, der står for regnskab, løn osv. Ansøgningsfrist er 20/08 og der vil blive afholdt samtaler løbende. Vores adresse er Trongårdsvej 60. 2800 Kgs Lyngby

title: PhD Fellowship in BioPhysics
description:
The Niels Bohr Institute, Faculty of Science at University of Copenhagen invites applicants for a PhD fellowship in computational modelling of active materials and their environment

Start date is (expected to be) 1 December 2026.

The project
Many microorganisms, such as bacteria and cancer cells, exhibit remarkable collective dynamics, often described as "living liquids" or active fluids, and arise due to local internal energy injection. Likeconventional liquids, the macro-scale confinement, or boundaries, of thfluid can control their flow patterns, and the micro-scale behaviour of the microorganisms. However, many physical systems exist within a deformable environment such as the mucus layers in the body.

As a result, not only does this living liquid get affected by its environment, but it can also reshape its soft surroundings as a form of mechanoreciprocity. This leads to a range of fascinating phenomena, such as cancer cells invading surrounding extracellular matrix, soil-dwelling bacteria burrowing through sand, and the infection of mucus by pathogenic bacteria. This research project will use computational models to explore the bidirectional relationship between an organism’s motility and its adaptable environment, investigating how microorganisms not only adapt to, but also actively restructure their surroundings.

This application is posted with a corresponding Postdoc position and only one of the positions will be filled.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for candidates interested in biophysical systems and computational physics, with preference for some knowledge about programming.

Our group and research- and what do we offer?
As a newly established research group, we utilize state-of-the-art computational models to study pattern formation in microorganisms. By combining discrete solvers, particularly a particle-based mesoscale hydrodynamic solver known as MPCD, with continuum simulations, we aim to characterize the collective dynamics of biological matter, their hydrodynamic interactions, and their influence on adaptable environments. This multiscale approach enables us to explore active systems that actively restructure their surroundings as effective ecosystem engineers.

We offer a highly creative and collaborative research atmosphere at the interface between physics, biology and fluid mechanics. Our research facilitates high performance computing facilities and actively encourage cooperation and or collaboration with the researchers who develop the numerical solvers used. The PhD fellowship is given in accordance with Danish legislation and will typically run for 3 years. The salary is set accordingly to Danish Union Contracts which are very competitive within the international academic community.

Principal supervisor is Dr. Kristian Thijssen, Niels Bohr Institute, kristian.thijssen@nbi.ku.dk.

Qualifications needed for the PhD programme
To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Physics. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

Terms of employment
Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

The terms of employment and salary are in accordance to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

Responsibilities and tasks

  • Carry through an independent research project under supervision
  • Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE
  • Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad
  • Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities
  • Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals
  • Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project
We are looking for the following qualifications:

  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Relevant publications
  • Relevant work experience
  • Other relevant professional activities
  • Curious mind-set with a strong interest in soft matter systems
  • Good language skills
Application and Assessment Procedure
Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Please include:

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)
  2. Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position
  3. Original diplomas for Bachelor or Master and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted.
  4. Publication list (if possible)
  5. Reference letters (if available)
The deadline for applications is 31 August 2026, 23:59 (CEST)
We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified, whether you will be passed for assessment.

The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified and, if so, for which of the two models. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process here.

Interviews with selected candidates are expected to be held in September

Questions
For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website.



The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

title: E-mail & Retention Specialist
description:
Marketing uden jakkesæt – vil du bygge vores e-mail- & abonnementsmotor?

Brænder du for e-mailmarketing, retention og datadrevet vækst – men har du nul lyst til stive corporate-miljøer, jakkesæt og tunge hierarkier? Hos Dokument 24 søger vi vores nye Email & Retention Specialist, der vil tage 100 % ejerskab over at opbygge og skalere vores e-mail- og abonnementsforretning.

Vi er en digital virksomhed, der gør jura enkel og tilgængelig for helt almindelige mennesker. Selvom vores produkt handler om jura, ligner vores hverdag et agilt e-handels- og tech-miljø: Vi går ikke i stive sko eller jakkesæt, og vi er et lille, tæt sammentømret team, hvor marketing og jurister sidder side om side, deler viden og løfter i flok.

Uanset om man sidder med marketing eller yder juridisk rådgivning, har vi én fælles besættelse: Vores kunder skal have en 5-stjernet oplevelse. Vores tårnhøje score på Trustpilot er vores stolhed og vores fælles pejlemærke for alt, hvad vi gør — lige fra den juridiske rådgivning til den næste e-mail, du opsætter.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du får ansvaret for at opbygge og drive vores næste store marketing- og vækstkanal. Du skal ikke bare skrive søde e-mails – du skal gennemtænke hele kunderejsen (lifecycle marketing), opsætte intelligente triggerflows ud fra kundedata og opbygge vores abonnementsprodukter over for både private og virksomheder.

Dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Automatiske triggerflows: Bygge og optimere e-mailflows baseret på kundedata (f.eks. automatisk opfølgning om testamente efter et skødekøb eller ejeraftale efter oprettelse af ApS).

  • Abonnementsforretningen: Udvikle og drive vores faste abonnementer til private og virksomheder (f.eks. selskabsvedligeholdelse og juridisk tryghed).

  • Retention & Churn: Analysere kundeadfærd og sørge for, at vores abonnenter bliver hængende, fordi de elsker værdien.

  • Menneskelig copywriting: Skrive skarpe, varme og konverterende e-mails på almindeligt dansk, som folk faktisk har lyst til at læse.

  • A/B-testing & tal: Nørde emnelinjer, sendetidspunkter, tilbud og landingpages ud fra målbare data (MRR, LTV, åbnings- og klikrater).

Hvem er du?

  • Du har erfaring med e-mail marketing og retention: Du har prøvet kræfter med e-mail automation og kunderejser før – gerne fra e-handel, SaaS eller abonnementsvirksomheder.

  • Du kender værktøjerne: Du er fortrolig med e-mail-platforme (f.eks. Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot eller tilsvarende).

  • Du tænker i data og mennesker: Du måler din succes på tal som genkøb og MRR, men du ved, at bag tallene sidder der rigtige mennesker, som skal have en 5-stjernet oplevelse.

  • Du er en holdspiller med hjerte: Du trives i et uformelt miljø, hvor man hjælper hinanden, deler ud af sin viden og lytter til kollegernes gode idéer – uanset om de kommer fra en marketingkollega eller en jurist.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Nul stivhed: Ingen jakkesæt, ingen tunge hierarkier og nul corporate-snobberi.

  • Et fantastisk lille team: Du bliver en helt central del af et hold, der kommer hinanden ved, støtter op og har det sjovt sammen på jobbet.

  • Fuld tillid og frihed: Du får ressourcerne og opbakningen til at bygge din egen kanal op, præcis som du mener, det gøres bedst.

  • Et stærkt produkt i ryggen: Det er markant sjovere at lave e-mailmarketing for en virksomhed, hvor kunderne reelt knuselsker produktet og belønner os med 5 stjerner.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdstid: Fuldtid (37 timer om ugen).

Arbejdssted: Hummeltoftevej 49, st., 2840 Virum

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.

title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager

Om rollen

 Som FP&A Manager har du en nøglerolle i at udvikle og styrke virksomhedens rapportering, business controlling, FP&A og BI på tværs af den danske forretning. Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

Ansøgningsfrist d.17. august 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og holder samtaler undervejs, da vi gerne vil finde den helt rette kandidat til stillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor interesserede til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.

Europcar Mobility Group is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe.  “We help to change the way you move” is what we stand for and brings us together.

Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® - a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® - a frontrunner at providing low-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox-Rent-A-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.
