title: Fullstack Product Engineer
description:
TL;DR - We’re seeking exceptional Fullstack Product Engineers to help build the future of AI. You will work across our entire stack to build features that will empower the next generation of creators and builders.

Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone build software with plain English. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Over 2 million people in 200+ countries already use Lovable to launch businesses, solve complex problems, and bring their dreams to life. And we’re just getting started.

We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value high ownership, high velocity and low-ego collaboration. We seek people who care deeply, challenge us, and are driven to build something of lasting impact.

What we’re looking for

    5+ years of experience building and shipping full-stack products
    Fluent in modern frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend development
    Solid understanding of systems design, performance tradeoffs, and scalable architecture
    Strong product sense and ability to make well-reasoned technical decisions, knowing when to prioritize speed and when to invest in foundational work

What you’ll do

In one sentence: Do all it takes to build a generational product and scale the core experience of lovable products

    Implement and maintain features across the full stack: frontend, backend and infra
    Own systems end-to-end: architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
    Collaborate closely with ML, design, and product teams to translate capabilities into intuitive, mind-blowing user experiences
    Drive the full development lifecycle, from technical planning to production launch and post-release improvements
    Contribute to shaping our technical direction, eng culture, and product strategy

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

    Frontend: React
    Backend: Golang and Rust
    Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
    DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

And always on the lookout for what's next!

How we hire

    Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.
    Complete a quick live coding exercise.
    Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
    Tell us about your most impressive project.

About your application

    Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
    We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Position at LeoVegas Group

ABOUT THE ROLE

Join our team as a Senior Software Engineer and play a crucial role in driving our organisation's growth through the development of outstanding products.

LeoVegas Group is building something special – a world-class team dedicated to creating the best Sportsbook platform in the market through cutting-edge technology and innovative gaming experiences.

This is a dynamic team that will be working on creating new cool features and integrating them into LeoVegas platforms.

We’re seeking a dynamic individual who can deliver state-of-the-art code while prioritising performance and scalability.

We are recruiting for our Tiger Sportsbook Team!

In Sportsbook we work in a high-volume, real-time environment, integrating data feeds with our modern trading system and transactional betting platform (UI/Backend). Your contributions will cover maintaining/expanding our current Betting/Trading services as well as building new services and capabilities for our users.

As a key member of our team, you’ll collaborate effectively while also demonstrating initiative and a passion for sharing innovative ideas.

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

● Taking ownership, problem-solving and collaborating with other teams.

● Designing and implementing from idea to production.

● Building for scale, availability, performance and security across the stack.

● Working with product managers, architects, QA engineers and other developers in a highly collaborative agile environment.

● Integrating new products and building internal services to support our ecosystem.

● Conducting code reviews and mentoring team members.

● Ensuring services are production-ready, observable, and maintainable through monitoring, alerting, and on-call participation.

OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

ESSENTIAL SKILLS:

● 6+ Years of software development experience with Java, Spring Boot and Event-Driven Architectures.

● Experience designing microservices, K8s, containerization (Docker) and Kafka messaging systems.

● Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases and caching.

● Implementing resilience patterns (e.g., retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation).

● Designing and maintaining monitoring dashboards (e.g., metrics, logs, traces) and alerts to proactively detect issues.

● Hands-on experience developing highly scalable RESTful end-to-end microservices.

NICE TO HAVES:

● Familiarity with Reactive Programming (e.g. RxJava) and Vert.x would be a big plus.

● Experience in platforms like AWS and Google Cloud Platform.

● Online gaming and gambling experience

    

WHO WE ARE

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

BENEFITS

    Hybrid work policy
    4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
    30 annual vacation days
    Occupational Pension
    5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
    Parental Leave Top-Up
    Possibility to enroll in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
    1,500 SEK equipment allowance
    Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts
    We offer a relocation package with accommodation and flights.

JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!



Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!

Dammsuga och dammtorka

    

Moppa golv och rengöra ytor

    

Tvätta, vika och stryka kläder

    

Byta lakan och bädda sängar

    

Göra det lilla extra som gör stor skillnad

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som:

    

Har en positiv inställning och god servicekänsla

    

Tycker om att hjälpa andra

    

Är noggrann och pålitlig

    

Kan tala enkel svenska eller engelska

    

Har B-körkort och egen bil

Ingen tidigare städerfarenhet krävs – vi utbildar dig!

🌍 Om Hemfrid

Hemfrid är ett av Sveriges största företag inom hushållsnära tjänster. Vi hjälper tusentals kunder varje vecka och sätter alltid kvalitet, trygghet och service i första rummet.

📌 Bra att veta

    

Vi gör bakgrundskontroll

    

Du behöver svenskt personnummer eller samordningsnummer

🚀 Vill du göra skillnad varje dag?

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team i Skövde!

✨ Looking for a Meaningful Job in Skövde? Join Hemfrid as a Cleaner! ✨

Do you enjoy creating order and a welcoming atmosphere? Do you like working independently and meeting new people?

We are now looking for new team members in Skövde – and no previous experience is required!

With us, your attitude matters most. We’ll teach you the rest.

🌟 Why Choose Hemfrid?

At Hemfrid, you get more than just a job – you get security, community, and opportunities to grow.

✔ Fixed monthly salary ✔ Permanent employment (50–85%) ✔ Collective agreement and secure employment terms ✔ Insurance and occupational pension ✔ Wellness allowance ✔ Paid training in home cleaning and service ✔ Opportunities to grow within the company ✔ Free mobile phone plan ✔ Friendly colleagues from all over the world

We invest in you – from day one.

🏡 About the Job

As a cleaner with us, you help people enjoy a clean, comfortable, and harmonious home. You work independently and are responsible for making sure the customer feels satisfied and safe.

Your tasks may include:

    

Vacuuming and dusting

    

Mopping floors and cleaning surfaces

    

Washing, folding, and ironing clothes

    

Changing bed linen and making beds

    

Doing the little extra that makes a big difference

🕗 Working hours: Monday–Friday, 8 am–5 pm (No evenings or weekends!)

Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who:

    

Has a positive attitude and strong service mindset

    

Enjoys helping others

    

Is careful and reliable

    

Can speak basic Swedish or English

    

Has a valid driver’s license (B) and access to a car

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:  Let's introduce ourselves  

Volvo Cars is growing and facing an exciting future in the electrification of vehicles. If you want to utilize state of the art methods to test and verify next generation electrified luxury cars, the role as our new Hardware in the loop (HIL) Development Engineer is the role for you to prosper!You will be part of an HIL Development team in the eART Software Factory within the Product Stream Electric Propulsion. You will be a member of a truly international team designing HIL test-environments for production software testing. Meaning the HIL models, you will create is crucial for testing electrical propulsion ECUs used in the Traction Battery, Charging and Electric Drive Systems.

     What you'll do  

Volvo Cars’ development centers around software (SW) and in our next generation vehicles, we take a giant leap into the future by launching a capable centralized compute platform, hosting most of the in-house developed SW. In these next generation vehicles, we are building a computer-in-the-car architecture.  The Propulsion & Energy unit is located at Gothenburg. The department, Propulsion & Energy Quality has an Enabling ART (Agile Release Train) within Propulsion & Energy, with the purpose to provide the infrastructure for SW development teams to integrate, test, and release SW in a continuous integration (CI) flow. The infrastructure includes development and maintenance of Hardware-in-Loop setups for development, verification, and validation of software products. We do this by building a robust and automated test framework and enabling SW test & release in a CI flow. We are looking for our future team member to develop, validate and maintain Model-Based Hardware in Loop setups that are intended for software functionality verification on embedded systems. The embedded test setups are built around the above-mentioned Propulsion & Energy architecture. These setups are a combination of simulated vehicle components and real hardware components to emulate a real vehicle with all the relevant dynamics. Our team are responsible for the development and maintenance of these embedded setups (hardware-in-loop), while making sure that these setups are capable to execute relevant test cases for platform, software, and function verification. These are state-of-the art test setups, critical for testing software before the final product is launched. Hence, you will be working in a fast paced, innovative environment, solving problems and challenges daily. We offer you to work in a small cross functional team, with high focus on quality and continuous improvements. Together with your colleagues, you will define, set up and configure these test environments supporting our current and future projects. You will be working with Software application and deployment on core computer and embedded ECUs, model all relevant components and signals to enable test automation, moving us towards Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment. Together with us, you will grow your competence and get a broad understanding of Volvo Cars Next Generation Vehicles and Software Platform along with domain growth in Propulsion & Energy. You will work closely with other groups at Volvo Cars, our suppliers and get the opportunity to create a wide network.

   Profile description: What you'll bring  

You will fit well in this role if you are a Modeling and Simulation Engineer focusing on model-based development on HIL test beds and an understanding of Software Verification cycles correlated to Model Based Development (SIL, MIL, HIL and VIL)We see that you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in SW Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent with emphasis on SW development. You have extensive experience in either dynamic modelling using Matlab/Simulink or test automation. Experience from an Agile working environment and from Continuous Integration is beneficial.You are fluent in English.




    Software/ Plant model development (python, Matlab/Simulink, Stateflow)
    Experience with HIL systems and real-time simulation
    Experience in Continuous Integration
    dSPACE toolchain (ConfigurationDesk, AutomationDesk, ControlDesk,...)
    Knowledge of modeling electric motors, power electronics, and traction battery systems
    Automation of software test
    CAN and Automotive Ethernet communications  



Meritorious:




    Experience from SW platform development, including middleware.
    Knowledge in Electric Propulsion simulation
    Knowledge in integration of sensor technologies
    Verification in vehicles at system or functional level or experience from test automation
    Experience in Core, Domain development/testing.

title: Testingenjör Getinge Disinfection
description:
Company description:

Vi erbjuder innovativa lösningar för operationsrum, intensivvårdsenheter, steriliseringsavdelningar och för Life Science och institutioner. Getinge befinner sig i en spännande tillväxtfas och söker nu en Test- och Verifieringsingejör till Getinge Disinfection AB:s F&U-avdelning i Växjö. Tjänsten erbjuder en driven ingejör möjligheten att arbeta med produkter som bidrar till att rädda liv i en produktionsorienterad och internationell miljö. Du kommer att tillhöra teamet Design Effectiveness och arbeta med validering och verifiering av nya och befintliga disk-desinfektorer. Testningen innefattar allt från mekanisk provning till kemiska, mikrobiologiska och biokompatibilitetstest. Kunskaper inom mikrobiologi eller ISO 10993 (biokompatibilitet) är meriterande. Tjänsten är placerad i Växjö.











Dina arbetsuppgifter








    Identifiera lämpliga testmetoder för att verifiera nya tekniska lösningar för att säkerställa funktionalitet och säkerhet på produkten.

Vi är ett engagerat och sammansvetsat team som värderar nyfikenhet, kreativitet och samarbete.















Vad du har med dig







I den här rollen ser vi att du har följande med dig:








    Relevant ingenjörsexamen inom bioteknik, maskinteknik, elektroteknik & automation eller liknande

    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift







Förutom tekniska färdigheter värderar vi din personlighet högt. Som person tror vi att du är strukturerad och noggrann men samtidigt öppen för olika tankar, idéer och input från dina kollegor. Vi ser att du är engagerad och driven i ditt arbete och att du trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med vår andra tekniska grupperingar inklusive vår produktion. Du är van att kommunicera med olika intressenter i en organisation och att samarbeta både i och utanför teamet.







På Getinge omfamnar vi en lärandekultur där vi tar ansvar för vår utveckling och sätter stort värde på kvalitet och samarbete. Framför allt bryr vi oss om varandra för att vi som team och bolag ska kunna fortsatta utveckla världsledande produkter. Vi är Team Players, Forward Thinkers och Game Changers!







Vi erbjuder



Vi erbjuder ett konkurrenskraftigt kompensations- och förmånspaket, inklusive friskvårdsbidrag, familjeförmåner och gemensamma aktiviteter och föreningsliv. Allt detta för att säkerställa att vi stöder ditt välbefinnande och dina mål.







Vi har en öppen dialog mellan ledare och medarbetare, samt mellan teamen. Vi fokuserar på att utveckla människor och tillsammans skapar vi en plan för lärande och kompetensutveckling när du börjar din karriär hos oss.







Ansökan



Ansökningar kommer att granskas löpande och vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 30 juni. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på knappen "ansök nu". På grund av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.







Om du har några frågor angående rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Johan Stridh på email: johan.stridh@getinge.com eller ansvarig rekryterare på emma.paulsson@getinge.com.







Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Vi hoppas att du vill följa med oss på vår resa mot att bli världens mest eftertraktade medicintekniska företag.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.

Denna position rapporterar till:

Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the

transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

Would you like to join our global sales and marketing team and grow ABB Metallurgy Products sales in the assigned export markets? ABB Metallurgy is the leading global supplier of Electromagnetic Stirring and Braking systems to the steel and aluminum industry. Metallurgy Products manufactures and sells EMS-systems and provides a wide range of benefits in the field of casting, melting and refining of steel and aluminum. Helping customers all over the world improve efficiency, save resources, and reduce emissions gives our work a powerful sense of purpose.

The position is located in Västerås, Sweden and requires frequent travels to designated markets up to 50% of the time.

You will be mainly accountable for:

• Manage sales of Metallurgy products in assigned markets with responsibility for sales volume and margin targets.

• Develop and implement market plan for designated markets, aligned with the

sales volume and margin targets. Performs regular status reviews and proposes

recovery plan(s) in cases of potential order shortfalls.

• Establishes and maintains effective customer relationships to understand

customer needs, promote customer understanding of full system offering, and

align to provide a solution. Ensures a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.

• Identifies and drives the development of new market opportunities.

• Ensures efficient marketing activities and value proposition to customers.

• Prepares offers in coordination with Global Sales Manager. Ensures appropriate technical and financial aspects of offers, including prices, and trading condition.

• Manages administrative procedures in sales processes and supports project

management activities when needed.

• Follow the industry trends and competitors within the industry to identifying risks and opportunities.

Qualifications for the role

• You have a relevant engineering or business degree.

• You are an experienced sales professional with >5 years’ experience from a B2B sales role in similar industries.

• Experience from the steel and/or aluminum industry is a big plus

• High spoken and written communication skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional “can-do” attitude.

• Full proficiency in English.

• Further the position requires a flexible person who can travel and react quickly to dynamic environment.

More about us

At ABB Metallurgy we produce electromagnetic stirrers to the steel and aluminum industries. Primary customers are steel and aluminum plants. In the R&D and Simulations department at ABB Metallurgy, existing calculation tools and newly developed multi-physics tools are employed frequently to address the benefits of using electromagnetic actuation in improving the customer processes within different steps of metal making, e.g. melting and casting. These models are continuously developed and used in actual customer projects to make sure sufficient performance is met, and that demands on process improvements can be guaranteed.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Want to Shape How Millions Pay on FINN, Blocket & other Nordic Marketplaces?

THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELLYou? A strategic product leader with a deep understanding of modern payment ecosystems. You thrive on navigating complex partnerships and driving cross-functional alignment to build seamless, secure financial experiences.Role? Product Manager on our Payment team, owning the vision, strategy, and execution of our payment solutions across our brands, bridging between external payment partners, technical delivery teams, and internal business stakeholders to scale our transactional capabilities.Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics go to find what they need, whether it's second-hand goods, a job, a home or a way to move. Location? Join us in our Oslo or Stockholm office where you’ll have the flexibility to work remotely 3 days a week. Why us? This is your chance to lead a fast-scaling transactional platform that directly impacts millions of Nordic users. You drive high-visibility partnerships, cultivate an evolving team culture, and experience dedicated personal and professional growth in a highly collaborative environment.Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    Proven experience building and leading digital products from concept to execution, with a deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and transactional models.
    You possess the influence and negotiation skills required to manage external payment providers and fintech partners, ensuring mutually beneficial, high-performing collaborations, as well as internal vertical stakeholders.
    You’re adaptable and can pivot smoothly when priorities shift based on business results and help your team navigate changes with steadiness.
    You combine vision with pragmatism: You have the ability to translate a 5-year vision into clear, actionable short-term wins that keep the momentum going.
    High professional-level fluency in English: You effortlessly manage internal stakeholders, translating complex technical constraints to business leaders and aligning business objectives with engineering realities.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?As our Product Manager for the Payments Team, you own the core transactional experiences that define our marketplaces. Your main objective is to lead the team in building the best transactional and payment solutions as a foundational core layer. You manage the balance between ambitious forward-thinking strategies and continuous, value-driven software delivery

Your Day-to-Day & Key Projects:

    Lead the continuous development of our new digital wallet and accelerate the cross-border scaling of our escrow solutions beyond Norway into our other Nordic markets.
    Evaluate and direct negotiations with major external payment vendors and financial partners to optimize our capabilities.
    Guide a dedicated squad of developers and UX designers, contributing to a structured, psychologically safe, and high-performing team culture.
    Interface closely with leadership across our commercial verticals to ensure the payments roadmap directly facilitates broader business goals.

What success looks like in 6 months to one year:

    You have built deep trust with the product team, smoothed out cross-location collaboration dynamics, established a consistent short-term delivery cadence, and assumed ownership of key external partner relationships.
    You have seamlessly scaled the payment/escrow solutions across multiple Nordic markets and established a sustainable, predictable product delivery structure that bridges long-term vision with operational realities.

A few words from Product Director, Lene Graff Christensen:

"Hi, I am Lene Graff Christiansen, Product Director of Marketplace Platforms. The Payments team builds the transactional heartbeat of our marketplace—and we are looking for a strong product mind to help us scale it.We are a collaborative and curious team that values deep ownership and turning bold visions into measurable results. I am looking for someone who will confidently own this domain, bring fresh industry insights to the table, and challenge our current way of thinking. If you are ready to tackle complex payment challenges, this is a fantastic opportunity to broaden your expertise, grow as a product leader, and make a massive impact on Vend’s future."

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you! Make sure to apply by August 19th. You don't need to write an application letter, we are more interested in your answers to the questions in the application form. QUESTIONS?Product Director Lene Graff Christiansen is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. Lene is best reached by e-mail: lene.graff[at]vend.com

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

title: Project Manager Payroll System Implementation
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will take a key role in a large-scale international transformation focused on payroll, HR processes, and connected systems. This assignment centers on end-to-end payroll system implementations across multiple countries, with a strong emphasis on discovery, governance, compliance, and a smooth transition into operations.

You will work close to stakeholders across HR, IT, Finance, vendors, and the business, helping shape future-state solutions for Payroll, Employee Life Cycle, and Time & Attendance. This is a great fit if you enjoy combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a complex global environment where you can make a clear and lasting impact.

Job Description

    You will lead payroll implementation projects from initiation through go-live and stabilization.
    You will drive country-specific discovery workshops to understand current processes and define future-state ways of working.
    You will set scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and governance for the project.
    You will create and maintain project plans, RAID logs, and status reporting for senior stakeholders.
    You will coordinate closely with HR, IT, Finance, payroll vendors, and business stakeholders across countries and functions.
    You will manage payroll system implementations, integrations, and data migration activities.
    You will ensure alignment with local payroll legislation, tax regulations, and internal governance.
    You will facilitate workshops, capture business requirements, and turn them into functional specifications.
    You will oversee SIT, UAT, parallel payroll runs, defect management, and deployment activities.
    You will follow up on resources, timelines, risks, and overall delivery to keep the program on track.
    You will support change management, training, knowledge transfer, and handover to operational support.
    You will provide clear updates to senior leadership and project sponsors.

Requirements

    Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience within Payroll, HR Transformation, or HRIS implementations.
    Proven experience leading payroll implementation projects in managed services environments.
    Strong hands-on experience with Workday.
    Demonstrated experience building and managing Workday-to-Payroll integrations.
    Solid understanding of payroll operations, compliance, and governance.
    Experience working with global, cross-functional teams.
    Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
    Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

    Experience with Strada payroll implementations.
    Experience supporting divestments, carve-outs, or business separation projects.
    Experience working in complex, multinational organizations.

title: Global Head of Brand Events 100%
description:
In short
As the fastest-growing global sportswear brand, reaching millions of runners worldwide, On is building an authentic community through direct fan interaction - across major sporting expos, run crews, cultural moments, brand events, and grassroots retail activations. We are looking for a Global Head of Brand Events to elevate our global event ecosystem, shaping the brand activation strategy, enabling tools and frameworks for scale, and developing innovative formats and partnerships across key markets. We are looking for someone with a strong entrepreneurial spirit who takes ownership, brings new ideas forward, and thrives in building and evolving a global function. The Brand Events team plays a critical role in bringing our community together and translating On’s mission into meaningful, memorable experiences around the world.

Your Mission
- Set the global strategic vision for brand activations and events at On
- Develop immersive event formats aligned with global campaigns and Go-To-Market initiatives
- Identify and implement tools and technologies to elevate event experiences and enable scale
- Source, negotiate, and manage partnerships with relevant organizations to drive event impact and success
- Promote and amplify the full range of On’s brand activations across channels and markets
- Define global event brand standards and ensure consistent execution across all
touchpoints
- Analyze event performance and data to drive continuous improvement and learning
- Enable and support markets to execute events in line with global brand guidelines
- Lead the development of communication frameworks across pre-, during-, and
post-event moments
- Grow and strengthen On’s global community and fan base through impactful activations
- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global team of brand activation and event experts

Your story
- 10+ years of experience leading and delivering global events, with a proven track record of impactful brand activations
- 7+ years of experience managing and developing high-performing teams
- Ideally, experience within a global sportswear, athletic, or performance brand, with a strong understanding of community-driven marketing
- Experience working in a creative agency environment (in-house or external), with a strong creative and solution-oriented mindset
- Deep expertise across physical, digital, and hybrid event formats at global scale
- Strong leadership skills, with experience operating in highly matrixed, international organizations
- Entrepreneurial, proactive, and driven to innovate, optimize, and build new approaches

Your Team
Your team shapes and delivers On’s global brand events—from campaign launches and athlete moments to community activations and key brand experiences. They ensure every event reflects our brand, supports our strategic priorities, and creates meaningful connections with our community.

Pour cela, nous cherchons : une personnalité technique expérimentée, très à l’aise dans l’environnement Microsoft, et motivée à contribuer activement à cette transformation.  
De quoi il s’agit  
Tu travailles sur le site de Sion et fais partie d’une organisation ICT active sur les deux sites. Ton domaine d’expertise se situe autour de Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Windows Server et des plateformes hybrides.  
Tu contribues à exploiter notre environnement actuel de manière stable, à le faire évoluer et à le standardiser progressivement. Pour cela, tu collabores étroitement avec les équipes de Sion et de Bellikon ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires externes.  
Ingénieur(e) ICT senior – Microsoft Cloud \& plateformes hybrides  
Tes missions:  
Tu exploites et fais évoluer nos plateformes Microsoft et d’infrastructure, en particulier Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory et Windows Server.  
Tu contribues au développement des identités hybrides, des accès sécurisés et de processus d’exploitation modernes.  
Tu participes aux sujets de virtualisation, backup, restore, monitoring et documentation d’exploitation.  
Tu aides à harmoniser l’infrastructure ICT entre Sion et Bellikon et à mettre en place des standards communs.  
Tu automatises les tâches récurrentes et rends l’exploitation plus robuste, transparente et efficace.  
Tu analyses les incidents de manière structurée, identifies les causes et mets en œuvre des solutions durables.  
Tu participes à des projets, par exemple dans la modernisation de la communication, des accès, des plateformes et des systèmes cliniques.  
Tu interviens en support 2e et 3e niveau et participes au service de piquet au sein de l’équipe.  
Tu sais situer les sujets réseau et sécurité dans l’exploitation et les traites avec les spécialistes internes et les partenaires externes.  
Ce que tu apportes  
Tu es un/e ICT Engineer expérimenté·e avec de très bonnes connaissances de l’environnement Microsoft, en particulier Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory et Windows Server.  
Tu as de l’expérience avec des environnements hybrides et tu comprends l’interaction entre cloud, systèmes locaux, identités, droits d’accès et accès sécurisés.  
Tu sais analyser de manière autonome des problèmes techniques complexes, en identifier les causes et mettre en place des solutions solides.  
Tu travailles de manière structurée, tu documentes clairement et tu veilles à ce que le savoir reste disponible au sein de l’équipe.  
Tu as l’ambition de ne pas seulement exploiter les solutions existantes, mais de les améliorer, les standardiser et les rendre plus stables sur le long terme.  
Tu comprends les principaux sujets réseau et sécurité dans l’exploitation, par exemple VPN, firewalling, segmentation, Aruba ou Palo Alto. Tu n’as pas besoin d’en être spécialiste.  
Tu parles très bien français. L’allemand ou l’anglais est un avantage pour la collaboration entre les deux sites.  
Ta seniorité repose sur une formation solide en informatique, une expérience pratique pertinente et la capacité à faire évoluer des environnements ICT exigeants de manière sûre. Des certifications Microsoft sont un plus.  
Ce qui t’attend chez nous  
Chez nous, tu travailles dans un environnement porteur de sens, dans lequel l’ICT contribue directement à la qualité de la prise en charge des patientes et patients. Tu prends des responsabilités dans une infrastructure importante, mais pas seul·e : nous faisons évoluer notre ICT ensemble, avec des standards plus clairs, des plateformes plus modernes et une collaboration plus forte entre les sites.  
Tu ne trouveras pas chez nous une ICT déjà parfaitement optimisée, mais une organisation en mouvement. C’est justement là que se trouve l’opportunité : tu peux contribuer, apporter ton savoir\-faire, rendre les améliorations techniques visibles et voir concrètement l’impact de ton travail.  
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  
Si vous recherchez un environnement où chaque journée est une opportunité d’apprendre, de grandir et d’impacter positivement la vie des autres, alors le service des soins de la CRR est fait pour vous ! Nos atouts:  
Accompagnement des patients sur le long terme : Suivez la progression des patients et contribuez directement à leur retour à l’autonomie.  
Environnement enrichissant : Collaborez avec des experts de divers domaines dans une approche interdisciplinaire.  
Formation continue : Accédez à un large éventail de formations pour renforcer vos compétences et développer votre carrière.  
Équipe dynamique : Travaillez dans un environnement bienveillant où les efforts sont reconnus et valorisés.  
Avantages sociaux : Prestations sociales élevées, nombreux avantages sociaux, place de parc gratuite, et bien plus encore .  
Modalités  
Date d’entrée en fonction : dès que possible  
Délai de réception : 17 août 2026

Et si vous nous aidiez à concevoir une société plus inclusive ?  
Située dans la région de Vevey, entre ville et campagne, la Cité du Genévrier accueille des personnes adultes en situation de handicap du fait d'une déficience intellectuelle. Structure pluridisciplinaire et multi\-sites, elle offre aux personnes accueillies un cadre de vie et de travail particulièrement harmonieux ainsi qu'un ensemble de compétences adaptées aux besoins et aux aspirations de chacun.  
Intégrée à la Fondation Eben\-Hézer, la Cité du Genévrier est dépositaire du testament moral de sa fondatrice, Sœur Julie Hofmann. Elle considère à ce titre le bonheur des personnes accueilles comme finalité ultime de son action.  
Mission  
Le groupe « Les Jalons » accompagnent 6 personnes adultes avec des troubles du spectre de l'autisme ainsi qu'une déficience intellectuelle et d'autres troubles associés comme de l'épilepsie. Les résidents sont âgés de 45 à 65 ans. La structuration du temps, la rigueur de l'équipe et la clarté des routines d'accompagnement soutiennent le résident dans son quotidien. La rencontre des personnes accompagnées et de leur humanité nous permettent de devenir des porte\-paroles dans leur connexion avec le monde extérieur.  
Le colloque d'équipe, en tant que pierre angulaire du groupe, permet de questionner les pratiques éducatives, de confronter les visions, à la recherche du débat permettant d'atteindre le consensus. Il est également un lieu permettant de prendre du recul face aux situations difficiles. L'équipe éducative, expérimentée et exigeante envers elle\-même, s'implique sincèrement dans l'accompagnement quotidien. Les qualités et les différences de chacun sont vues comme une richesse et l'humour et la solidarité sont des ressources essentielles à l'équilibre de l'équipe. Afin de compléter l'équipe éducative, nous cherchons un éducateur social (H/F).  
Profil souhaité  
Etre au bénéfice d'un diplôme d'éducateur ES/HES ou d'un CFC d'assistant socioéducatif ou d'un CFC d'ASSC  
Expérience ou connaissances des troubles du spectre autistique et des troubles du comportement, un atout  
Sens de l'organisation et intérêt pour le travail pluridisciplinaire  
Rigoureux, être toujours dans le défi et la remise en question de la pratique dans une visée évolutive  
Aimé être bousculé dans le quotidien professionnel  
Réflexif, proactif et motivé, savoir se positionner  
Une main de dentellière dans un gant de chef d'orchestre, cela vous parle ?  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels, possédez un permis de conduire et êtes disposé à effectuer des horaires irréguliers y compris durant les week\-ends.  
Cadre de travail  
Nous vous offrons l'opportunité de prendre part à un projet novateur et d'évoluer dans un environnement de travail propice à la réalisation de la mission et à votre épanouissement professionnel. Dans le cadre de ce contrat de durée indéterminée, vous pourrez bénéficier d'un programme de formations internes intéressant et varié, ainsi que des conditions et prestations sociale de la CCT du secteur social parapublic vaudois, avec 8 semaines de vacances, 9 semaines dès l'âge de 50 ans.

description:
Chef de projet MCR/CVC Automaticien Régulation PLC/AdB  
Conception, réalisation et suivi de systèmes de régulation numérique (MCR AdB) pour la gestion et la supervision d'installations techniques dans le domaine du chauffage, de la ventilation et de la climatisation (CVC). Mise au point des boucles de réglage, optimisation de la gestion de l'énergie, implémentation des fonctions de sécurité et de redondance, traitement des alarmes techniques, gestion de l'éclairage. Prise en charge de sites tels que : bâtiment administratifs, centre commerciaux, maison de maître. Maitrise de l'allemand (ou mieux, du Suisse Allemand) un véritable plus.  
Planung, Realisierung und Überwachung von digitalen Regelsystemen (MSR) zur Steuerung und Überwachung von technischen Anlagen im Bereich Heizung, Lüftung und Klimatisierung (HLK). Entwicklung von Regelkreisen, Optimierung des Energiemanagements, Implementierung von Sicherheits\- und Redundanzfunktionen, Verarbeitung von technischen Alarmen, Beleuchtungsmanagement. Betreuung von Standorten wie: Verwaltungsgebäude, Einkaufszentrum, Herrenhaus. Deutschkenntnisse erforderlich.  
Chef de projet MCR/CVC Automaticien Régulation PLC/AdB  
S\+T Service \& Technique SA () est une entreprise dynamique avec plus de 45 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la gestion technique / automation du bâtiment (GTB) et l'une des rares PME romande qui s'est donné les moyens de développer en interne ses propres produits hardware et software pour assurer les tâches de régulation numérique d’installations de chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC) : supervision WEB/Cloud (), gestion du confort, de l´énergie, de l´éclairage, des alarmes techniques, intégration des systèmes domotiques, traitement des données BigData fournies par les bâtiments, reporting automatisé (/).  
Notre équipe de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB) gère les projets de régulation numérique d'installation de chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC), de l’étude à la réalisation, pour des bâtiments de moyenne à grande envergure, tel que centres commerciaux, bâtiments administratifs, hôtels, maisons de maître, etc.  
S\+T compte aujourd'hui près de 50 collaborateurs regroupant ainsi sous un même toit un savoir\-faire pluridisciplinaire unique et reconnu. Des outils CAO performants (système Digimat), développés spécifiquement en collaboration avec l’équipe R\&D interne, permettent de trouver des solutions modernes et efficaces aux problèmes les plus complexes. Une équipe de techniciens/régleurs assure sur le terrain les mises en service et les opérations de maintenance.  
Vous aurez pour mission la gestion de projets de régulation numérique dans le domaine de l'automation du bâtiment (CVC) en utilisant des outils informatiques performants notamment pour assurer progressivement les tâches suivantes (principalement avec les systèmes d'automation Digimat) :

Nous recrutons, pour le compte de notre client, un·e Chef·fe de Projet Structures, afin de renforcer une équipe d'ingénieurs reconnue pour son expertise dans la conception et la réalisation de projets complexes.  
Notre client est un bureau d'ingénieurs établi en Suisse, intervenant sur des projets variés dans les domaines du bâtiment, des infrastructures et des ouvrages techniques. Son développement constant repose sur une approche alliant excellence technique, proximité avec les clients et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques et innovantes.  
Votre rôle  
En tant que Chef·fe de Projet, vous prenez la responsabilité de mandats de structures depuis les premières phases d'étude jusqu'à la réalisation des ouvrages.  
Vous intervenez comme interlocuteur privilégié des maîtres d'ouvrage, architectes et partenaires du projet. À ce titre, vous coordonnez les différents intervenants, assurez le suivi technique et financier des affaires et veillez au respect des objectifs de qualité, de coûts et de délais.  
Votre expertise vous permet d'apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée dans les choix techniques et les orientations constructives, tout en garantissant la faisabilité et la cohérence globale des projets.  
Vos responsabilités  
Vous pilotez les études de conception et participez activement au développement des solutions techniques les plus adaptées aux contraintes des projets.  
Vous coordonnez les équipes de projet, assurez le suivi des prestations et veillez à la bonne circulation des informations entre les différents intervenants.  
Vous supervisez les calculs, les modélisations et la production des documents techniques nécessaires à l'exécution des ouvrages.  
Vous accompagnez les clients et partenaires tout au long du projet, en leur apportant des conseils techniques pertinents et une vision claire des enjeux.  
Vous participez aux séances de coordination et assurez le suivi des travaux afin de garantir la conformité des réalisations aux exigences définies.  
Enfin, vous contribuez au développement du bureau par la qualité de vos réalisations et la confiance que vous instaurez avec vos interlocuteurs.

Votre mission principale sera d'accompagner nos utilisateurs au quotidien, d'assurer le support applicatif et technique, de coordonner les besoins IT des sociétés filles et de contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos outils, en assurant l'interface aussi bien avec les utilisateurs qu'avec la direction de chaque société.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Demenzbetreuung 80-100% für die Region Gossau gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Gossau suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Demenzbetreuung.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Gossau

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Demenzbetreuung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Gossau

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Gossau liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage zwischen Stadt und Natur. Sie erreichen den Ort bequem mit der Bahn und haben gute Autobahnanbindungen. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein vielfältiges Gewerbegebiet mit etablierten Unternehmen sowie eine ausgezeichnete Infrastruktur. Gossau verbindet attraktive Arbeitsplätze mit hoher Lebensqualität und grünem Umfeld.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Demenzbetreuung in Gossau

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Demenzbetreuung

Die Demenzbetreuung arbeitet person-zentriert: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Mensch mit seiner Biografie. Sie gestalten deshalb einen Alltag mit festen Ritualen sowie vertrauten Handgriffen, erkennen nonverbale Signale und begegnen Unruhe mit Ruhe.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Demenzbetreuung in Gossau verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Gossau verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern mit Spezialisierung in Demenzbetreuung, da die älter werdende Bevölkerung spezialisierte Betreuung benötigt. title: Senior Specialist Data Science
description:
Senior Specialist Data Science  
The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with 92\.6 billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us on  
Senior Specialist Data Science  
Location: Vers\-Chez\-les\-, Switzerland  
Work model: Hybrid / Full time  
Contract type / duration: Permanent  
Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.  
As a Senior Specialist Applied Mathematics \& Digital Biology at Nestlé Research, your mission is to apply advanced mathematical modelling, data science, scientific artificial intelligence and digital biology to transform complex health, nutrition, clinical and biological data into predictive, interpretable and experimentally actionable insights. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, data scientists, computational biologists, clinical and translational researchers, nutrition experts, digital teams and external scientific or technology partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.  
How you'll make an impact as a Senior Specialist Applied Mathematics \& Digital Biology  
Leading applied mathematics and digital biology approaches that advance predictive, mechanism\-based health and nutrition research.  
Developing advanced mathematical, statistical and computational models that strengthen scientific decision\-making across research programs.  
Translating complex biological, clinical, nutritional, microbiome and omics data into clear insights that support discovery, validation and innovation.  
Building artificial intelligence\-enabled analytical workflows that help project teams move from descriptive analysis to predictive and decision\-ready science.  
Guiding cross\-functional teams in using robust models, reproducible workflows and actionable recommendations to accelerate health\-benefit innovation.  
Lead and strengthen future\-ready digital biology capabilities through scalable models, workflows, scientific frameworks, and strategic partnerships that accelerate innovation and reinforce Nestlé's leadership in digital biology.  
What will make you successful  
Bringing strong expertise in mathematical modelling, statistical learning, machine learning, causal inference, optimisation, predictive modelling and mechanistic modelling.  
Applying quantitative methods to complex health, nutrition, biological, clinical, microbiome, omics or experimental datasets.  
Leveraging digital biology approaches (including digital twins, virtual cells scientific, agentic AI and foundation models) to accelerate discovery and innovation  
Collaborating across research, data science, clinical, nutrition, digital and experimental teams while communicating complex models in a clear and engaging way.  
Communicating fluently in English.  
Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing\-oriented mindset.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:  
Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)  
Paid holidays beyond legal requirements  
Learning and development opportunities to grow your career  
Performance based bonus  
Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program  
Strong employer contribution to your pension plan  
Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions  
Attractive employee discounts across various products and services  
What to expect from our hiring process  
We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.  
The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.  
Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager - Electronics
description:
Strategic Sourcing Manager

Purpose of the role

  *  Developing and executing global sourcing strategies for the assigned direct materials categories (electronics)
  *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in Business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)
  *  Sustaining the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and providing supply capability and capacity at best cost to support future business needs and protect brand value
  *  Applying aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments, and development approaches to establish and actively manage a performing and regulatory-compliant supply base footprint
  *  Contributing to the enhancement of supply base performance on Quality, Delivery, and Cost (QCD)
  *  Realizing measurable value of >3% in recurring and P&L-effective cost reductions per year across the global third-party spend in the assigned categories through leveraged and benchmarked supply base management
  *  Growing and further developing a qualified and performing Best Cost Country (BCC) supply base in line with company and operations objectives, preferably in Eastern Europe, while managing a sustainable spend allocation


Responsibilities:

  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)
  *  Accountable for contributing to global Direct Material & Supply Base Performance (QCD)
  *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization
  *  Accountable for category-specific achievement of objectives related to cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint, and Best Cost Country Sourcing
  *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats, and opportunities within assigned categories (e.g., raw materials)
  *  Actively contributing to the bottom-up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with defined company objectives
  *  Acting as the interface to Business Units and Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along the PDP (IP07) process
  *  Acting as a change agent toward key stakeholders
  *  Developing category sourcing strategies using defined methods and tools
  *  Managing supplier relationships across the global supply base within assigned category scope, in alignment with category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia, and Romania
  *  Ensuring consistent application of all sourcing levers
  *  Contributing to key sourcing KPIs
  *  Assembling and actively leading category-specific and cross-functional sourcing boards
  *  Actively monitoring and conducting supply base risk assessments across assigned categories
  *  Participating in and contributing to the continuous improvement of direct material sourcing practices


Qualifications:  

  *  3-4 years of in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with solid knowledge of global category management
  *  Demonstrated experience with category-specific production techniques and processes
  *  Knowledge of category sourcing markets
  *  Proficiency in Office software and IT applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  *  Experience sourcing in Eastern Europe and Asia, including Best Cost Country sourcing and spend relocation activities
  *  Experience working within a global and complex organization
  *  Experience in machine building, vacuum technology, and semiconductors
  *  Experience in cross-functional and category team management (at least functional leadership)
  *  Strong interpersonal, sensitive, and empathetic communication skills with suppliers, colleagues, and internal stakeholders
  *  Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills with a focus on key facts
  *  Ability to achieve results through others, manage multiple priorities, set priorities effectively, and handle pressure
  *  Good communication skills in German and English; additional languages are a plus

title: Ingénieur géotechnicien confirmé
description:
Ingénieur géotechnicien confirmé H/F  
Lieu : canton de Genève \& Vaud  
Taux d’activité : 70 à 100 %  
Contrat : CDI  
Expérience requise : 5 ans minimum  
Présentation de Géocimes  
Depuis près de 30ans, Géocimes est un bureau d’études indépendant spécialisé en géologie, hydrogéologie et géotechnique. Implantée dans les régions de Genève et d’Annecy, l’entreprise intervient auprès de maîtres d’ouvrage publics et privés, de collectivités, de bureaux d’ingénieurs et d’entreprises de construction.  
Nos missions concernent notamment les fondations, les ouvrages de soutènement, les terrassements, les fouilles, la stabilité des pentes et des massifs rocheux, les eaux souterraines, les risques naturels, l’instrumentation et le suivi de travaux géotechniques.  
Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité en Suisse, nous recherchons un·e ingénieur·e géotechnicien·ne confirmé·e capable de prendre en charge des projets avec un niveau élevé d’autonomie.  
Description du poste  
Rattaché·e directement à la direction, vous assurez la gestion technique et opérationnelle de projets géotechniques, depuis l’analyse du besoin du client jusqu’au suivi des travaux.  
Vous intervenez sur des projets variés en Suisse romande et participez progressivement au développement et à la structuration de l’activité de Géocimes Suisse.  
Vos principales missions  
Analyser les demandes des clients et définir le périmètre des prestations ;  
réaliser des visites de terrain et établir les premières hypothèses géologiques et géotechniques ;  
définir et organiser les campagnes de reconnaissances : sondages, essais, prélèvements et instrumentation ;  
superviser les entreprises de sondage, les laboratoires et les intervenants spécialisés ;  
interpréter les résultats des reconnaissances et des essais géotechniques ;  
établir les modèles géologiques, hydrogéologiques et géotechniques ;  
définir les paramètres de calcul et les hypothèses de dimensionnement ;  
rédiger les rapports, notes techniques, expertises et recommandations ;  
réaliser et superviser les calculs géotechniques ;  
concevoir et dimensionner des fondations, soutènements, blindages de fouilles, ouvrages de drainage, remblais et terrassements ;  
étudier la stabilité des pentes, talus et massifs rocheux ;  
préparer les pièces techniques des dossiers d’appel d’offres ;  
analyser les offres des entreprises et participer aux séances de coordination ;  
assurer le suivi d’exécution et les contrôles de chantier ;  
mettre en oeuvre des essais et contrôles de chantier ;  
adapter les recommandations aux conditions réellement rencontrées sur le terrain ;  
assurer le suivi des délais, des heures, des budgets et de la rentabilité des affaires ;  
préparer les offres techniques et financières ;  
entretenir la relation avec les clients, mandataires, administrations et entreprises ;  
contribuer au développement commercial de l’activité ;  
participer à l’amélioration des méthodes, modèles de documents et outils internes.  
Le poste comporte une part importante de travail de terrain, de rédaction technique, de calcul et de relation client.  
Profil recherché  
Diplôme d’ingénieur en génie civil avec spécialisation en géotechnique, diplôme d’ingénieur géologue ou formation équivalente ;  
formation EPF, HES ou diplôme étranger reconnu comme équivalent ;  
au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle en géotechnique ;  
expérience dans la gestion autonome de projets, de préférence au sein d’un bureau d’ingénieurs ;  
maîtrise de la mécanique des sols et des principes de géologie de l’ingénieur ;  
expérience dans le dimensionnement des fondations, soutènements, fouilles, terrassements et ouvrages géotechniques ;  
capacité à interpréter des campagnes de reconnaissances et des essais in situ ;  
bonnes connaissances des normes SIA et des Eurocodes ;  
La maîtrise de logiciels de calcul géotechnique tels que TALREN, K\-REA, LARIX est indispensable.  
excellente maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit ;  
bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et aptitude à produire des documents techniques clairs et argumentés ;  
permis de conduire indispensable ;  
autorisation de travail valable en Suisse.  
Sont également appréciées :  
la maîtrise d’un logiciel SIG, notamment QGIS ou ArcGIS ;  
des connaissances en hydrogéologie et en mécanique des roches ;  
une expérience en instrumentation géotechnique : piézomètres, inclinomètres et suivi de mesures ;  
une connaissance des procédures et exigences des CFF ou de l’OFROU ;  
une expérience des marchés publics et appels d’offres ;  
des compétences en pollution des sols et des eaux souterraines ;  
de bonnes connaissances en allemand oral et écrit.  
Qualités attendues  
Autonomie et sens des responsabilités ;  
rigueur technique ;  
capacité d’analyse et de synthèse ;  
organisation et respect des délais ;  
aisance sur le terrain ;  
capacité à prendre des décisions et à gérer les imprévus ;  
bon relationnel avec les clients et les entreprises ;  
capacité à travailler au sein d’une petite structure ;  
polyvalence, réactivité et esprit d’équipe ;  
intérêt pour la transmission des connaissances et l’amélioration des méthodes de travail.  
Ce que nous proposons  
Des projets variés en géologie, géotechnique, hydrogéologie et risques naturels ;  
une forte proximité avec le terrain et les chantiers ;  
une autonomie réelle dans la conduite des projets ;  
une relation directe avec les clients et la direction ;  
des circuits de décision courts ;  
la possibilité de contribuer directement au développement de Géocimes Suisse ;  
des responsabilités techniques, commerciales et organisationnelles élargies ;  
une rémunération définie selon l’expérience, les compétences, le niveau d’autonomie, et des résultats commerciaux,  
Une perspective d’évolution pouvant conduire, à terme, à la reprise de Géocimes Suisse. jpidd9e16fajm jpit0731jm jpiy26jm

description:

Millennium has differentiated itself from other investment management firms through our consistent ability over the last 35 years to generate returns that have not been correlated to the general market.

The talent and dedication of our people are critical to our success. We offer an opportunity for developing one’s professional career while working with individuals trained in a variety of disciplines in a collegial and dynamic environment. We also offer a broad range of competitive benefits on a global basis.

Role: Operations Specialist
Office Location: Zug (CH)

The successful candidate will support the Equities Volatility business through robust derivatives trade management and post-trade operations oversight. They will manage the end-to-end lifecycle for listed derivatives activity, ensuring accurate trade capture, allocations, clearing, reconciliations, and exception resolution. The role requires strong control discipline, stakeholder management, and the ability to operate effectively in a high-volume, risk-sensitive environment.

Principal Responsibilities

Oversee end-to-end listed derivatives trade lifecycle, including trade capture, allocations, clearing, and position management.
Monitor and resolve exchange vs. books and records breaks across trades, positions, and cash.
Manage internal and external position transfers, give-ups / give-ins, and clearing broker coordination.
Support regulatory and exchange reporting requirements, including control enhancements and exception management.
Partner with PMs, trading desks, brokers, exchanges, and internal teams to ensure accurate operational support.
Drive STP improvement, process efficiency, and operational scalability across the platform.
Qualifications/Skills Required

10+ years’ experience in listed derivatives operations, trade management, clearing, and reconciliations.
Strong knowledge of exchange-traded derivatives lifecycle and post-trade controls across EMEA and as well as US markets.
Experience managing exceptions, regulatory reporting, and exchange / CCP-related operational processes.
Strong stakeholder management skills across trading, client service, compliance, brokers, and vendors.
Experience working across global teams and supporting change, migrations, and new product onboarding.

The Portfolio Manager will support a Senior Portfolio Manager in the systematic trading of interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and long-dated currency derivatives across developed and emerging markets, generating high-quality risk-adjusted returns through the effective deployment of allocated Firm capital.

What You’ll Do
Formulate and implement relative value investment strategies across global fixed income and macro markets.
Manage a multi-currency, multi-product portfolio with a focus on generating strong risk-adjusted returns through disciplined risk-taking and scalable capital deployment.
Identify and execute trading opportunities across linear and non-linear rates products, including swaps, options, cross-currency instruments, sovereign rates products, and related macro instruments.
Conduct fundamental and quantitative analysis across macroeconomic, geopolitical, central bank, and market-technical factors to generate trade ideas and inform portfolio positioning.
Develop and enhance analytical infrastructure, data frameworks, and tools, including PnL analytics, PCA modelling and back testing, to support investment decision-making, portfolio construction, and risk management.
Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders and external counterparties to support effective portfolio implementation, market access, and trading outcomes.
Monitor positions, exposures, liquidity, and risk limits on an ongoing basis, and optimize execution and trade efficiency on a cost-adjusted basis.
Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.

Qualifications/ Skills Required
At a minimum a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
Minimum of 10 years of experience trading global fixed income rates and macro markets (including G10 markets with a specific focus on Japan and Australia), with substantial expertise in interest rate derivatives, cross-currency products, and related relative value strategies - specifically Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Cross-Currency Swaps (Xccy), and Bonds.
Minimum of 2–3 years of portfolio management experience managing a macro / interest rate / FX relative value investment strategy within an institutional trading environment.
Experience operating successfully in a high-performance trading environment and working collaboratively within a team of investment professionals.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-currency, multi-product portfolios across both developed and emerging markets.
Experience conducting independent research into market trends and activity across global cross-currency markets.
Strong expertise in trading and portfolio management of linear and non-linear rates products, including interest rate swaps, options, cross-currency derivatives, and sovereign fixed income instruments.
Strong analytical, mathematical, portfolio construction, and risk management skills, with the ability to evaluate complex exposures across multiple products and market regimes.
Experience building, enhancing, or applying quantitative models, risk analytics, and trading tools to support portfolio optimization and investment decision-making is essential.
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders, sell-side counterparties, data providers, and senior management.

Unser Mandant ist ein führendes, inhabergeführtes Traditionsunternehmen mit Sitz in Nänikon. Seit über 100 Jahren steht das Unternehmen für herausragende Expertise in der Befestigungstechnik. Mit innovativen Eigenmarken und Systemlösungen für Umbau, Renovation und professionelle Anwendungen im Bau\- und Industriebereich hat sich das KMU eine starke Marktposition erarbeitet.  
Das Unternehmen beschäftigt rund 70 engagierte Mitarbeitende und ist auf seine tiefe Verwurzelung am Werkplatz Schweiz sowie seine internationale Präsenz in über 40 Ländern. Wir können gerne telefonieren!  
Deine Mission:  
Qualität und Effizienz auf dem nächsten Level  
Als Leiter/in Operations übernimmst du eine zentrale Schlüsselrolle. Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für die Bereiche Qualitätsmanagement, Qualitätssicherung, Einkauf, Logistik und Montage.  
Ein besonderes Highlight dieser Position: Du übernimmst die treibende Rolle bei der Vorbereitung und erfolgreichen Umsetzung der ISO\-9001\-Rezertifizierung im Frühjahr 2027\. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung berichtest du direkt an den CEO. Du gestaltest die strategische Ausrichtung der operativen Prozesse aktiv mit und führst dein Team (bestehend aus den Leitenden für Einkauf und Logistik sowie Mitarbeitenden in der Montage) mit Weitblick und Empathie.

Qualitätsmanagement \& ISO 9001: Überprüfung, Aktualisierung und Optimierung des QM\-Systems; Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Audits sowie die Förderung einer gelebten Qualitätskultur.

Einkauf \& Logistik: Personelle Führung der erfahrenen Bereichsleitenden sowie die strategische Weiterentwicklung der Beschaffungs\- und Logistikprozesse.  
Montage: Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen und wirtschaftlichen Ablaufs in der Fertigung von Eigenprodukten.  
Die Ausgangslage ist optimal:  
Der bald pensionierte Stelleninhaber wird die operativen Aufgaben schrittweise und im Rahmen einer sorgfältigen Einarbeitung übergeben, um sich zukünftig auf die Produktentwicklung konzentrieren zu können.

Führungspersönlichkeit mit KMU\-Herz  
Du bist eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Freude daran hat, in einem agilen KMU\-Umfeld etwas zu bewegen. Du bringst nicht nur die fachliche Tiefe mit, sondern auch die soziale Kompetenz, um Menschen zu begeistern und mitzunehmen.  
Das bringst du mit:  
Mehrjährige, fundierte Berufserfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement und in der Qualitätssicherung  
Tiefgehende Kenntnisse der ISO\-9001\-Norm und nachweisbare Erfolge in deren praktischer Umsetzung

Beruflicher Hintergrund im industriellen oder Bau\-Umfeld (Produktion, Handel oder Supply Chain)  
Gute Kenntnisse im Prozessmanagement, im Einkauf und in der Logistik  
Abgeschlossene technische Grundausbildung mit Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/FH (Betriebs\-, Produktions\- oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen)  
Spezifische Weiterbildung im Qualitätsmanagement (z.B. Qualitätsmanager SAQ, Lead Auditor ISO 9001\)  
Persönlich überzeugst du durch eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Durchsetzungskraft und klare Kommunikation. Du hast Freude daran, Prozesse kontinuierlich zu hinterfragen und zu optimieren.

title: Human Factors Engineer
description:
Human Factors Engineer
----------------------

Roche Schweiz bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our longstanding client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a

**Human Factors Engineer**
==========================

**Background:**

Roche Diagnostics Global Customer Experience and Solution Design Team (CXSD team) is looking for a passionate Senior Human Factors Engineer to redefine Roche User Interface and Product design and transform the Healthcare industry for the better. At CXSD you will join an international group of designers that serve our purpose to bring the voice of customers to the core of Roche Diagnostics decisions by designing and enabling a seamless patient-centric experience across our portfolio of products and services. You'll be part of building design maturity for Roche with peers who are passionate, energetic, and caring in a connected, multicultural, highly motivated team.

As a Human Factors Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of the next generation of medical devices that can diagnose critical diseases. You will be responsible for leading and documenting studies aimed at providing insights for the development team to improve the design as well as to provide objective evidence that the design outputs of a certain phase in the product development life-cycle are meeting all requirements.

**The Perfect Candidate** has more than 5 years of experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management. Additionally, the person is experienced in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software, as well as in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field. Also, the person is knowledgeable of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering. Lastly, the candidate communicates fluently in English.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Be the voice of patients and Roche users in every product-related discussion
* Identify user profiles, tasks, hazard-related use scenarios, usability risks, and requirements
* Responsible for translating UX research insights, user needs, business requirements, and technical requirements into pleasant and efficient User Experiences
* Responsible for creating medical device usability deliverables according to IEC 62366
* Create and facilitate workshops with the product teams to gather system-level information and to coordinate the design deliverables
* Plan formative and summative usability studies and coordinate external suppliers in the process
* Prepare, maintain, and review Usability Engineering Files
* Advocate for accessibility, quality, and usability for end-users at Roche Diagnostics
* Provide guidance and mentorship to more junior designers supporting them on professional development, output, and productivity

**Must Haves:**

* Master's degree in Science, Industrial Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, or other related technical field
* Min. 5 years experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management
* Experience in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software
* Experienced in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field
* Experience collecting and analyzing physiological and behavioral data
* Experience in creating, facilitating, and analyzing workshops with customers and stakeholders
* Excellent presentation skills and ability to communicate know-how, experiences, ideas, solutions, and deliverables effectively and persuasively
* Knowledge of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering
* Fluency in English. Other languages are always a big plus

**What is offered:**

* A chance to contribute to one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies
* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting zones
* Central location with motorway connection and train station nearby
* Varied work profile
* Home office possibility
* Training opportunities through temptraining
* Collaboration in a dynamic and motivated team
* Good remuneration

You are welcome to send your complete application documents to Mr. Severin Räfle.

Chemistry Pharma Pharmacy Diagnostics Zug Lucerne Full-time Research Laboratory

Kenntnisse agiler Methoden (Scrum, Kanban)

Kein Problem – wenn dich die Rolle anspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.
